 Honourable Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund
 Order
Date : 20.02.2023 Heard Mr. N Dubey, learned counsel for the petitioner and also heard Ms. SH Bora, learned Addl. PP, appearing for the State Respondent.

The petitioner, namely, Meenakshi Dey has filed an application under section 438 Cr.P.C., with prayer for pre-arrest bail as she is apprehending arrest in connection with Tezpur PS Case Page No.# 2/2 No.370/2022 under sections 420/376 IPC .
The petitioner's younger brother has a relationship with the informant and he is also willing to marry the informant but he has been booked in the present case under sections 376/420 IPC.
The petitioner has prayed for bail on the grounds of parity because the main accused have already been given interim protection.
It is submitted that the petitioner will cooperate with the investigation.

I have considered the submissions at the bar and to consider the bail application the case diary is Meenakshi Dey vs The State Of Assam on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104625517/

sentences.text: Call for the case diary fixing the matter on 23.03.2023.

In the interim, and in the event of his arrest,
the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs.50,000/- with a local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority under the conditions that:
i. The petitioner will co-operate with the investigation.
ii.
The petitioner will appear before the IO within 10 (ten) days; and iii. The petitioner will not exercise threats to witness and tamper with the evidence.
